responsibility: Provides the RISC-V hooks needed by the D front end. It defines D target version identifiers based on XLEN and hard-vs-soft float configuration and registers `__traits(getTargetInfo)` handlers such as `floatAbi`, translating backend ABI state into D-specific compile-time target information.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file of the RISC-V D front-end support: it computes D target versions and `floatAbi` strings from backend state such as `TARGET_64BIT`, `TARGET_HARD_FLOAT`, and `riscv_abi`. Unlike `riscv-d.h`, it contains the executable hook logic rather than just declarations and macro bindings.
